22.name: Episode 1
22.overview: Thalia is faced with a new challenge at work, Katryn finds evidence of Ella’s infidelity, and Tracy and Tertius clash over Leah. Binneland’s shareholders make a decision about the co-head position at Ongevalle.

22.name: Episode 2
22.overview: Dewald refuses to give up, Uys notices something that doesn’t sit right with him, and Joe is thrown in at the deep end.

22.name: Episode 3
22.overview: Thalia tries to hide the fact that Binneland’s new doctor fascinates her, Tracy finally puts her foot down regarding her and Leah, and Hannah expects something from Nicolette that is almost impossible.

22.name: Episode 4
22.overview: Ella feels guilty about using Tracy, but Johan convinces her that it isn’t wrong. Dewald meets Liv and is surprised when she doesn’t fall for his charm, and Uys realises how difficult it is for Nicolette to be out of the operating room.

22.name: Episode 5
22.overview: Conrad presents an idea to Binneland’s board, but Johan has his reservations. Nicolette realises just how much she has missed being in the operating room, and Dewald feels that Henry doesn’t trust him.

22.name: Episode 6
22.overview: Ella and Johan try to delay Conrad’s project, and Hannah feels jealous of Uys and Nicolette’s relationship. Nicolette’s fear of the operating room is diffused and she receives another job offer.

22.name: Episode 7
22.overview: Conrad tries to ease some of Tracy’s pressure, but she isn’t happy about it. Nicolette is torn over the new job offer, and Johan becomes more determined to stop Conrad’s project before it gets underway.

22.name: Episode 8
22.overview: At gets an unexpected visitor on the farm, Liv finds something interesting in Dewald’s locker, and Uys decides to talk to Nicolette about her job offer.

22.name: Episode 9
22.overview: Tracy and Conrad visit At’s farm, where he tells Conrad that he feels uneasy about the project. Nicolette suggests that Uys go away with her. It seems that Dewald and Liv are getting along better, but she has other plans.

22.name: Episode 10
22.overview: Nicolette makes a decision about her future. Dewald gets a taste of his own medicine, and Joe and Ella declare a tentative ceasefire. At warns Conrad that he is playing with fire.

22.name: Episode 11
22.overview: Hannah is heartbroken when she learns about Nicolette’s plans, Dewald succeeds in sabotaging Liv, and At confronts Conrad about his friendship with Tracy.

22.name: Episode 12
22.overview: Both Thalia and Liv are furious with Dewald and demand that he fix what he has broken, Johan visits At on the farm, and Binneland says goodbye (for now) to an aspiring young doctor.

22.name: Episode 13
22.overview: At and Conrad are at loggerheads over Johan, Hannah wants to cheer up Uys, and Dewald finally apologizes.

22.name: Episode 14
22.overview: Johan Matthys’ true identity is revealed to the board, and Ella pretends she didn’t know. Dewald and Liv call a truce - albeit a temporary one - and Thalia is stunned when she learns about Dewald’s admission of guilt.

22.name: Episode 15
22.overview: Dewald makes a big decision about his mentor, and Thalia knows of someone who is romantically interested in Bonnie. Tracy doesn’t want to tell Tertius about Conrad.

22.name: Episode 16
22.overview: Bonnie and a patient’s friendship grows and he tells her about a website where he shared his life story. Johan shares something with Tertius that leaves Tracy speechless.

22.name: Episode 17
22.overview: Both Conrad and Johan try to persuade Binneland’s board members before a meeting, Bonnie sends a message on a chat site, and Henry makes a decision about Dewald’s future.

22.name: Episode 18
22.overview: While everything seems to go wrong for Conrad, At places more trust in Johan. Henry has a change of heart, and Bonnie struggles to feel enthusiastic about a romantic date.

22.name: Episode 19
22.overview: There seems to be no end to the big decisions Tracy is making, and Bonnie is unaware that the friend she's chatting to online is starting to develop feelings for her.

22.name: Episode 20
22.overview: Uys starts to panic when he can’t get hold of Nicolette, Thalia opens the door to an unexpected visitor, and everyone tries to understand why Hannah is in a bad mood.

22.name: Episode 21
22.overview: Louis and Naomi grow increasingly worried about Hannah’s behavior, and Hannah wishes she could speak to Nicolette, but no one can reach her.

22.name: Episode 22
22.overview: Le Roux is admitted to Binneland and gets an unexpected diagnosis. Hannah finally reveals to Naomi what has been bothering her, and Bonnie tells “Surferdude” about her possible romantic date with a friend.

22.name: Episode 23
22.overview: Kristin wants to get in touch with Le Roux’s biological mother, Naomi fears that Hannah might run away again, and Thalia warns Bonnie not to play with men’s feelings.

22.name: Episode 24
22.overview: Luke struggles to come to terms with the fact that Bonnie is possibly dating someone. Tensions rise when Le Roux’s biological mother meets his adoptive mother face to face, and Hannah finally tells Naomi the truth.

22.name: Episode 25
22.overview: Kristin finally realises the true severity of Le Roux’s condition, Bonnie reads Luke’s fortune, Jackie’s phone rings, and Joe gets the surprise of a lifetime.

22.name: Episode 26
22.overview: Joe makes a potentially life-changing decision, while a phone call leaves Louis and Naomi in a difficult position. Meanwhile, although unintentional, Bonnie finds herself playing with a nice guy’s feelings.

22.name: Episode 27
22.overview: It’s Annetjie’s big day, Naomi makes contact with Jackie, and Thalia is confronted with a strange request.

22.name: Episode 28
22.overview: Bonnie is determined to meet “Surferdude” in person, Joe sets out to confirm whether he is related to someone, and Naomi is forced to come clean to Louis after taking matters into her own hands.

22.name: Episode 29
22.overview: Naomi tries to placate Hannah’s fears, Thalia discovers the true identity of “Surferdude”, and Joe receives the results of his DNA test.

22.name: Episode 30
22.overview: Joe accuses Anya, convinced that a certain Binneland patient is another man’s child. Jess receives big news, and Bonnie witnesses Luke’s vulnerable side.

22.name: Episode 31
22.overview: “Surferdude” almost reveals his true identity, and Bonnie gets suspicious. Jackie wants to start over and has Naomi’s support, and Le Roux’s identity leads to shock and confusion.

22.name: Episode 32
22.overview: Joe feels that too much pressure is being placed on Jess, while Bonnie feels betrayed. Louis is willing to give Jackie another chance - but only under certain conditions.

22.name: Episode 33
22.overview: In his desperation, Joe takes a dangerous step, Naomi’s kindness ultimately softens Louis, and Bonnie is determined to cut a friend out of her life.

22.name: Episode 34
22.overview: Joe searches for his mother, believing that desperate times call for dangerous measures. Louis tries to hide the presence of a new employee, and Bonnie is confused about her emotions.

22.name: Episode 35
22.overview: Thalia confronts Luke about Bonnie, Petro grows concerned about Joe and the demands of a dangerous man, and Louis opens up to Uys.

22.name: Episode 36
22.overview: Joe finds a way to contact his mother, Bonnie decides to check in on a patient, and after an accident at Mimi’s, Louis begins to develop a newfound respect for Jackie.

22.name: Episode 37
22.overview: Joe is in turmoil as he struggles to come to terms with his identity - Petro wants to help but feels powerless. Luke is head over heels in love, Hannah wants to see her mother, and Uys meets Jackie for the first time.

22.name: Episode 38
22.overview: Ella receives a second threatening email, Tracy begins to wonder whether she might be missing out on something, Brian defends Jackie, and Petro supports Joe.

22.name: Episode 39
22.overview: Ella is haunted by someone who seems to know a great deal about her past. Louis must correct a major mistake he has made, and the challenges Tracy faces are not becoming any easier.

22.name: Episode 40
22.overview: Tertius wants to save Tracy from financial ruin, Jackie struggles with the fact that she is no longer a part of Hannah’s life, and Frieda du Pont meets Henry Louw.

22.name: Episode 41
22.overview: Tracy struggles to secure funding for Tonik’s upgrades, Bonnie feels increasingly unwell at work but Ella refuses to let her go home, and Frieda gives a doctor an ultimatum.

22.name: Episode 42
22.overview: Ella is in turmoil over a threat, Jackie reappears, and Uys learns that more patients have developed wound infections at Binneland.

22.name: Episode 43
22.overview: Frieda confronts a doctor at Binneland, and Henry witnesses the encounter. Tracy is excited to work alongside a possible new partner, while Petro feels neglected by Joe.

22.name: Episode 44
22.overview: Petro is frustrated with her relationship with Joe, Louis helps Tracy with Tonik, and Ella, Johan, and Henry underestimate an infection problem that is on the verge of spiralling out of control.

22.name: Episode 45
22.overview: Tracy officially gets a new business partner, while Thalia’s plans with Dewald go awry. The net around Ella tightens, and she is forced to make a few drastic decisions.

22.name: Episode 46
22.overview: Ella desperately tries to convince Binneland’s management of her innocence, Tracy is annoyed with Louis and his suggestions to save money, and Thalia is confused about Dewald’s feelings towards her.

22.name: Episode 47
22.overview: Ongevalle is shut down for a deep clean, Louis drops a bold new business proposal for Tonik, rattling Tracy, and Frieda arrives – ready to take full revenge.

22.name: Episode 48
22.overview: Bonnie encourages Thalia to ask Dewald out, Frieda shows up at Henry’s rooms, and Tracy has a serious talk with Louis.

22.name: Episode 49
22.overview: Just as Henry and Ella seem to be working on their issues, Joe receives shocking news. Louis starts conducting market research on Tonik, and Tracy is livid. Meanwhile, Petro gives Joe’s Refentse ticket to Dewald.

22.name: Episode 50
22.overview: Tracy and Tertius finally reach a peaceful balance in their co-parenting relationship. Thalia is upset when it becomes clear that Dewald has feelings for someone else, and the truth about a doctor’s identity leads to a dramatic turn of events. Refentse performs in Doepa!

22.name: Episode 51
22.overview: A once-happy relationship between two colleagues is left in tatters after a betrayal. Thalia meddles in other people’s affairs, and while Tracy continues to face challenges at work, her personal life gradually begins to improve.

22.name: Episode 52
22.overview: Ella makes an almost impossible request to Johan. Tracy struggles to sign the divorce settlement agreement, and Bonnie reveals Thalia’s closely guarded secret to Petro.

22.name: Episode 53
22.overview: Tracy receives an unpleasant surprise that catches her off guard. Disillusioned by recent events, Thalia blames a friend, while yet another Binneland doctor considers resigning.

22.name: Episode 54
22.overview: Johan is faced with deciding the outcome of a disciplinary hearing, Tracy continues to struggle with the reality of her divorce, and tension between Dewald and Thalia make for a highly uncomfortable situation.

22.name: Episode 55
22.overview: Ella and Dewald clash over the treatment of a patient, Tracy suddenly feels like a new person, and Johan unexpectedly hears from someone from his past.

22.name: Episode 56
22.overview: Petro kicks off with a leadership programme, and Joe feels lonely. Tertius and Leah reconnect, and Katryn returns to Pretoria – but she wants no one other than Dewald to know about it.

22.name: Episode 57
22.overview: Johan is sceptical about the cause of a car accident. A secret Naomi is keeping on behalf of a friend prevents her from being honest. Petro grows increasingly concerned when Joe starts behaving out of character.

22.name: Episode 58
22.overview: Johan believes Katryn’s life is in danger, Uys convinces Tertius to stay with Tracy while he is in Pretoria, and Joe is determined to find his biological mother.

22.name: Episode 59
22.overview: Joe is desperate to uncover his real identity, and Petro makes a breakthrough. Things become noticeably more comfortable between Tertius and Tracy, and Johan is on edge when Katryn has to undergo surgery. Meanwhile, a dangerous former Binnelander makes her appearance.

22.name: Episode 60
22.overview: Tertius devises a plan with Tracy, while Johan is once again reminded that he will do anything to protect his daughter. In his search for the truth, Joe reaches yet another dead end.

22.name: Episode 61
22.overview: Annetjie offers to help Petro with a presentation, and Tracy is consumed by guilt over Tertius and Leah. Ella advises Johan to be honest with Katryn.

22.name: Episode 62
22.overview: Katryn receives a visitor, At makes Tertius aware of everything he is giving up in South Africa, and Joe discovers potential new clues about his biological mother.

22.name: Episode 63
22.overview: Katryn gets a private nurse, but the nurse conceals her true identity. Petro is anxious about her presentation, and Joe offers little support. Meanwhile, Tertius, Tracy and Leah find themselves together in At’s farmhouse.

22.name: Episode 64
22.overview: Johan becomes suspicious of Katryn’s seemingly innocent and helpful nurse. The peace and quiet on At’s farm does everyone good, and Rian receives a very unexpected and unwelcome guest.

22.name: Episode 65
22.overview: Tertius and Tracy make a bet, Rian’s guest withholds important information from him, and Joe accidently overhears a conversation between Uys and Petro, leaving him furious.

22.name: Episode 66
22.overview: Tertius shocks Tracy with a very big question, and Uys confronts Joe for driving a wedge between him and Petro. Johan becomes concerned when Katryn starts sleeping excessively, and finally puts two and two together. Meanwhile, a dangerous trap is set, putting someone’s life in danger.

22.name: Episode 67
22.overview: Petro is willing to give up a major opportunity, while Joe continues to push her away. An impossible decision threatens to destroy a marriage for good, and Katryn uncovers the truth about Amor.

22.name: Episode 68
22.overview: Petro is frustrated with Joe, and Johan and Katryn both suspect the other of hiding something. Tertius is not willing to give up, and Tracy contacts Conrad.

22.name: Episode 69
22.overview: Tracy makes a big decision regarding her future, Joe is once again on the hunt for answers about his past, and Dewald suspects that Katryn might be having a nervous breakdown.

22.name: Episode 70
22.overview: Tracy informs her attorney and her friends about her decision, Joe considers hiring Botes to find his mother, and Ella sees a photo of Cecile.

22.name: Episode 71
22.overview: The reality of Tracy’s decision finally sinks in, Ella offers Katryn a job at Ongevalle, and Joe and Botes clash.

22.name: Episode 72
22.overview: Katryn accepts Ella’s job offer, and Rian corners him about Johan and Amor. Joe knows he has to let go of Petro, and two beloved Binnelanders say goodbye to their friends.

22.name: Episode 73
22.overview: Joe finally gets a lead on his birth mother, but the truth leaves him more uncertain than ever. Meanwhile, Hannah’s teacher asks Louis to come in for a meeting.

22.name: Episode 74
22.overview: Louis makes Thalia an official offer, Joe suspects that his birth mother has passed away, and Naomi invites a doctor to move in with them.

22.name: Episode 75
22.overview: Concert fever is running high - both Louis and Hannah are very excited. Henry is on the warpath when someone tries to poach his personnel, and Naomi and Annetjie bury the hatchet.

22.name: Episode 76
22.overview: Thalia is torn about her future, Naomi is anxious about the costume she has to make for Hannah, and Joe receives an unexpected visitor.

22.name: Episode 77
22.overview: Naomi asks Annetjie for help and immediately regrets it. Joe learns more about his past, and Henry gives Dewald an ultimatum.

22.name: Episode 78
22.overview: Naomi is on her own when it comes to Hannah’s concert costume, Joe cherishes the start of a new family bond, and Thalia gains a new admirer.

22.name: Episode 79
22.overview: Joe makes a connection, Dewald helps Robbie to ask Thalia out, and Botes devises (another) ruthless plan.

22.name: Episode 80
22.overview: Robbie sends Thalia flowers, but Henry intercepts it. Uys clicks why Hannah is stand-offish with Katryn, and Botes is caught in Louis and Naomi’s home.

22.name: Episode 81
22.overview: Thalia’s friends are very excited on her behalf, Hannah is suddenly less enthusiastic about her school play, and Joe is not happy when someone threatens to go home.

22.name: Episode 82
22.overview: Joe’s life is in danger, Robbie convinces Thalia that a certain doctor did them a favour, and Naomi tries to understand why Hannah is unhappy about the school play.

22.name: Episode 83
22.overview: Uys starts growing suspicious when he catches someone snooping around in Joe’s room. Thalia encourages Petro to give someone a chance, while she herself has her head in the clouds.

22.name: Episode 84
22.overview: Petro, Uys and Bonnie try to warn Joe, Hannah almost admits to Katryn why she’s lost her passion for the play, and a car accident convinces Bonnie to question a paramedic’s character.

22.name: Episode 85
22.overview: Joe feels betrayed, and Petro is there to pick up the pieces. Katryn is torn and puts pressure on Hannah. Bonnie warns Thalia that she is playing with fire.

22.name: Episode 86
22.overview: Joe gets more information about his past, Thalia is determined to stay loyal to a guy who doesn't have the approval of her friends, and Naomi is still in the dark about Hannah’s attitude.

22.name: Episode 87
22.overview: Petro and Bonnie disagree on something, the truth about an accident is revealed, and Joe is not at all impressed with Botes’ latest plan.

22.name: Episode 88
22.overview: Dewald tells Bonnie more about an incident, Henry gives Thalia an impossible assignment, and Yvonne receives an unexpected phone call.

22.name: Episode 89
22.overview: Katryn wants to boost Hannah’s self-confidence. Thalia decides she can have the best of both worlds, and Joe is determined to confront his biological father.

22.name: Episode 90
22.overview: Joe tries to make sense of someone's shocking death, Robbie begins to doubt his future, and Thalia is uncertain about her own dreams. Hannah surprises everyone with her self-confidence.

22.name: Episode 91
22.overview: At’s positive attitude towards Henry is a thorn in Johan’s side, Max takes Joe under his wing as a father figure, and Steve Abrahams surprises At.

22.name: Episode 92
22.overview: At defends Steve, Johan is frustrated, and Luke is ready to start working again. Meanwhile, Thalia remains uncertain and indecisive about her future.

22.name: Episode 93
22.overview: Johan makes an unsolicited assumption about a colleague's privacy, Hannah's big night has finally arrived, and Joe says goodbye to one of the most important people in his life.

22.name: Episode 94
22.overview: At approaches Steve with a major opportunity at Thusanang, Katryn and Henry clash over the way he treats his patients, and Uys gives Bonnie advice about Luke.

22.name: Episode 95
22.overview: Ella accidentally overhears a conversation she shouldn't have, Henry refuses to let Katryn assist a patient in his operating theatre, and Uys warns Bonnie not to put too much pressure on Luke.

22.name: Episode 96
22.overview: Bonnie arranges a picnic for Luke, Henry agrees to a request, and Katryn is dumbfounded. Ella wrestles with whether to share her suspicions about Steve with Johan.

22.name: Episode 97
22.overview: Bonnie thinks she has found the man she will marry, Ella is worried about information that might reach At, and Francie’s operation was possibly a success.

22.name: Episode 98
22.overview: Katryn begins to wonder if Henry is hiding something, Johan grows increasingly suspicious about Steve's involvement with Thusanang, and Bonnie realizes Luke is sick and fears she is the cause.

22.name: Episode 99
22.overview: Bonnie is in dire straits when Luke’s parents start making demands, Johan tries to manipulate At, and Katryn is suspicious of Henry’s ethics. The Thusanang visit turns into a crisis.

22.name: Episode 100
22.overview: Henry tries to find out why Katryn is looking for footage, Thalia asks Uys to speak to Luke's parents, and At confronts Johan about the chaos unfolding at Thusanang.

22.name: Episode 101
22.overview: Dewald witnesses a dangerous incident in the theatre and doesn't know what to make of it, while two colleagues helping out at Thusanang can't keep their hands off each other.

22.name: Episode 102
22.overview: Bonnie thinks Luke is acting unfairly, and Katryn confronts Henry. Johan suspects Ella wasn't honest with him, and he is shocked when he hears about At's plans.

22.name: Episode 103
22.overview: Ella shares more information about Steve with Johan, Bonnie’s heart breaks for a patient, and Katryn realizes what her father is up to and wants to warn Henry.

22.name: Episode 104
22.overview: A patient is furious after having her leg amputated, Steve must prove his innocence, and Ella smells a rat. Henry struggles to get an appointment with a neurologist.

22.name: Episode 105
22.overview: Steve is determined to expose a Binnelander. Uys has a serious conversation with Luke, and Henry goes for medical tests.

22.name: Episode 106
22.overview: Steve is taken by surprise by a sudden turn of events in an investigation, Katryn tries to encourage Henry, and Uys gives Bonnie more advice about her relationship with Luke.

22.name: Episode 107
22.overview: Ella has to make an important decision, Luke gets an unexpected job opportunity, Katryn and Henry search for answers together, and At makes a shocking decision regarding a doctor's role at Binneland.

22.name: Episode 108
22.overview: Bonnie decides it is time to have a frank conversation with Luke, two doctors try very hard to deny the feelings between them, and Ella has to say goodbye.

22.name: Episode 109
22.overview: An unexpected visitor bearing shocking news places Uys in a difficult situation. Mercia is finally honest about a major blunder she committed, and Johan is not being honest about his feelings.

22.name: Episode 110
22.overview: Mercia has to pull a rabbit out of a hat, and Joe thinks Uys is playing with fire. Dewald is becoming increasingly frustrated, and Johan warns Joe to watch his back.

22.name: Episode 111
22.overview: Molefe tells Bernie she can go home, but Petro has other plans. Katryn comes to Henry’s defence when Dewald confronts him - and Henry surprises her with an invitation to dinner. Thalia struggles to juggle all her jobs, while Mercia hatches a plan to sell tea.

22.name: Episode 112
22.overview: Uys is worried about Petro’s attempts to help Bernice, Mercia tries to manipulate Louis, and Ella finds out who warned Joe against her.

22.name: Episode 113
22.overview: Mercia starts working at Tonik, while Ella confirms that Johan is targeting her. Luke manages to convince Petro to hold Bernice back - but for how long?

22.name: Episode 114
22.overview: Mercia digs herself deeper into trouble, while Katryn and Henry decide to keep a decision under wraps. Petro and Uys clash over Bernice’s future, and Ella feels as though her life is falling apart.

22.name: Episode 115
22.overview: Mercia is fired up to prove she is a long-term solution for Tonik, an unexpected guest shows up at Henry’s place, and Uys tries to manipulate Bernice to leave Pretoria.

22.name: Episode 116
22.overview: Mercia is unstoppable, Johan outsmarts Ella, and Bernice and Thalia realise they have something in common.

22.name: Episode 117
22.overview: While Thalia is getting more emotionally involved with Bernice, Lana challenges Bernice about her lies. Johan hears Ella acted unprofessionally and has an idea, and the nurses find a loophole in Tonik’s loyalty system.

22.name: Episode 118
22.overview: Bernice receives a threat, Mercia begs Naomi to keep quiet about her blunder, and Johan continues with his revenge plan.

22.name: Episode 119
22.overview: Bernice refuses to be intimidated, attracting even more media attention in the process. Joe begins to suspect that Johan deliberately set Ella up for trouble, while Dewald confronts his mother over her interference in Henry’s practice.

22.name: Episode 120
22.overview: A social media post causes major unhappiness, while Joe realises that Johan has a personal agenda. Meanwhile, a mysterious package threatens to cause complete havoc.

22.name: Episode 121
22.overview: Petro decides to tell Uys the truth about the threats against Bernice, Mercia works on another plan, and Johan has Ella in a corner.

22.name: Episode 122
22.overview: Dewald wants to ask Katryn out, but gets a nasty surprise. Naomi keeps Mercia’s secret, Molefe has information that she does not want to share, and Bernice sees footage she should not have.

22.name: Episode 123
22.overview: Bonnie returns home, only to find a stranger in her bed. Wilmien tries to play matchmaker; and Mercia’s money making scheme does not go according to plan.

22.name: Episode 124
22.overview: Another one of Mercia’s plans goes awry, Bernice’s emotions are in turmoil, and Ella is rebuffed by Henry and takes it out on Johan.

22.name: Episode 125
22.overview: Louis confronts Mercia about her unsuccessful plans, Uys uncovers who was behind all those threats against Bernice, and Katryn is forced to tell Johan the truth about Henry.

22.name: Episode 126
22.overview: Katryn stands her ground when Wilmien criticises Henry, Naomi has a solution for Mercia’s problem, and Bonnie is still on the warpath when everyone sidelines her. Ella makes a decision that may have far-reaching consequences.

22.name: Episode 127
22.overview: Uys receives a message that unnerves him about something he sees as his responsibility. The news of a sudden resignation has the entire Binneland in a state of uproar. A possible visit has Louis and Naomi worried.

22.name: Episode 128
22.overview: Everyone is talking about a picture of Nicolette and a certain doctor, and Nicolette shares news with Uys. Hannah is excited about her brother’s visit, and Dewald is offered the job of his dreams.

22.name: Episode 129
22.overview: Wilmien reveals something that upsets Katryn, and a relationship comes to an end. Joe becomes suspicious and launches an investigation, and Livan’s visit is not without incident.

22.name: Episode 130
22.overview: Petro is worried about Uys, Naomi and Louis have to make a decision about Livan coming to stay with them for the holidays, and Katryn is uncomfortable in Dewald’s company.

22.name: Episode 131
22.overview: Hannah feels it is unfair that Livan can miss school, Joe is worried that Uys is acting strangely, and Freek is worried that someone might recognise him.

lastEpisodeToAir.name: Episode 110
lastEpisodeToAir.overview: Mercia has to pull a rabbit out of a hat, and Joe thinks Uys is playing with fire. Dewald is becoming increasingly frustrated, and Johan warns Joe to watch his back.

nextEpisodeToAir.name: Episode 111
nextEpisodeToAir.overview: Molefe tells Bernie she can go home, but Petro has other plans. Katryn comes to Henry’s defence when Dewald confronts him - and Henry surprises her with an invitation to dinner. Thalia struggles to juggle all her jobs, while Mercia hatches a plan to sell tea.

overview: یک سریال آبکی آفریکانزی زبان آفریقای جنوبی. داستان آن در بیمارستان خصوصی خیالی درمانگاه بینلند در پرتوریا و در اطراف آن اتفاق می‌افتد و داستان آن تجارب سخت، آسیب‌های روحی و مصیبت‌های کارکنان و بیماران بیمارستان را دنبال می‌کند.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The first 16 episodes of the season were an hour long, airing on Thursdays at 18h30. The show became a daily half-hour soapy on 27 January 2007 with a further 72 half-hour episodes.

seasons.name: Binneland Sub Judice
seasons.overview: The sixth season featured a raft of changes to the show, not least of which its title: Binnelanders officially becomes Binneland Sub Judice. The show also became an hour in length - the first South Africa daily drama to do so.

seasons.name: Binneland
seasons.overview: After one season as a daily hour-long soap known as Binneland Sub Judice, the show reverted to a half-hour daily soap and changed names for a third time, to Binneland.

title: Binnelanders
